appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)' in bold, black text at the top of the chart.
Y-axis label is 'Units Sold' in black text, vertically aligned along the left side of the chart.
X-axis label is 'Product' in black text, centered below the product category labels.
Y-axis has major gridlines and ticks at intervals of 10,000, from 10,000 to 80,000, with labels at each major tick.
X-axis has labeled tick marks for 'Product E', 'Product A', 'Product C', 'Product D', and 'Product B', positioned under each bar.
All bars are solid dark red.
The bar for 'Product E' reaches a height slightly above the 10,000 mark, approximately 12,000 units.
The bar for 'Product A' reaches a height slightly below the 80,000 mark, approximately 79,000 units.

public_definitions: goal: Review the weekend pop-up Units Sold by Product dashboard, then complete the Product E sales review intake by selecting the appropriate merchandising route.
chart_reference: Use the Units Sold by Product dashboard as the evidence source for the Product E merchandising route.
